end.summary:
Harsh practised reading and plotting ordered pairs.
They identified quadrants from coordinate signs.
They placed points on axes and reflected a point across the x-axis.
They initially treated (3,2) and (2,3) as the same point; this was corrected later.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised moving x steps horizontally first and y steps vertically second, identifying quadrants, and reflecting points in an axis. They explained that a negative x-coordinate means left and a positive y-coordinate means up, and later corrected the mix-up between (3,2) and (2,3) by tracking each coordinate’s direction and distance. At home, practise plotting a few ordered pairs and ask Harsh to say the horizontal and vertical moves separately.
